title: SpatialContrastSettings
description: Settings for the SpatialContrast sync task.

window_size.description: Temporal-only contrast uses one spatial sample; spatial modes use an odd side length from 3 to 255 pixels.

temporal_window_size.description: Number of frames in the temporal window; in pool_statistics mode, the number of group images to pool.

method.description: Direct sliding-window kernel or FFT-based box convolution.

squared_output.description: Return corrected squared contrast instead of contrast K.

unbiased_variance.description: Apply the finite-sample correction to the variance estimate.

poisson_noise_scale.description: Subtract poisson_noise_scale / mean from the squared contrast.

pool_statistics.description: For squared spatial contrast, average corrected variances and means over the temporal input groups before dividing by the squared pooled mean. Negative corrected variances remain negative.
